attBesluta.text: Vevor just blows my mind with their selection and pricing of these sets. I used this set for pressing bearings, for which it worked great, and foresee it being even more useful for installing shaft seals. Each disc is plenty rigid and nicely machined, with chamfered edges, and the fitted case is about perfect.

Bought for 20 ton shop press and maybe bearing work. Chamfer on OD is a bit more than I'd like. But for price, there is just no way I could make them for double the price. And at the sale price, there is no excuse to be without them. Five stars for the price, 4 stars if they were double the price with the same chamfer.

Another great product with a good price from Vevor. Simple tool that does what it's designed to do for a cheap price. Quality is good.
I have used it several times without any problems.

This tool did the trick. Very heavy duty. The access to the actual joint was very limited and there was no way I would have been able to remove the rusted bolts from the exhaust system blocking my access. I was able to find an angle though and get the fork end to slip into place. After only 2-3 pulls, I saw movement! Prior attempts with pry bars and a hammer were futile. Now I can either keep it or re-sell it as it has everything in a nice carrying case.
